blocks.html: Robinsons Sports and Leisure (RSL), the entertainment, sports, and wellness arm of Robinsons Land, is bringing fitness enthusiasts together through GX Sports In Motion, a hybrid fitness challenge that offers a fresh take on HYROX, the standardized indoor fitness race that is rapidly gaining popularity among the Philippines' growing fitness and wellness communities.

Set to take place on September 5 and 6 at the Robinsons Galleria Activity Area, the event is expected to attract athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and wellness advocates eager to experience the excitement and challenge of a HYROX-inspired competition.

"The primary reason we mounted GX Sports In Motion is to provide a venue where performance meets play, fitness meets community, and sport becomes part of everyday life," shared Ramon Rivero, Head of Robinsons Sports and Leisure.
As one expression of the broader GX Sports platform, GX Sports In Motion reflects the brand's commitment to creating more opportunities for people to move, play, and connect through sport.

The event will feature three activity zones and six challenge stations, allowing participants to simulate key elements of a HYROX race. These stations include Row, Ski, Weighted Squats, Weighted Lunges, Alternating Dumbbell Snatch, and Burpees Over the Line, offering a well-rounded test of endurance, strength, and functional fitness.
All registered participants will receive a Race Kit, exclusive GX Sports merchandise, and special participant perks they can enjoy once GX Sports opens its doors.
Registration for GX Sports In Motion is open until September 1. Participants may register at https://gxsports.helixpay.ph/
For event updates and more from GX Sports, follow GX Sports and Robinsons Sports and Leisure on Facebook and Instagram.
